items.title: Get form messages by email
items.detail: 1 form(s) came across. Messages are kept in OpenSpace; choose where to get an email when someone writes.

items.title: Check special features
items.detail: Your old site had add-ons (chat, booking or other widgets). See which ones you still need.

items.title: Use your own font licence
items.detail: Your old site used adobe-garamond-pro (from Adobe Fonts) and proxima-nova (from Adobe Fonts), which we're not allowed to copy, so the closest free fonts stand in (EB Garamond, Sofia Sans). If you have a web licence, download the font files (WOFF2) from the font service and upload them in Site Styles → Your fonts — they're stored in media/fonts/ — then choose them for your headings and text.
